title: utania cuspidata
intro: Utania cuspidata, commonly known as the Cuspidate Utania or simply Utania, is a species of plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various forms of folk medicine, particularly in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and as an antidote for snake bites. The health benefits of Utania cuspidata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of Utania cuspidata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
